Merger Agreement:
“Corporate Material Adverse Impact” shall mean any change, event, circumstance or effect that either (a) substantially diminishes the Company’s operating capability, liquidity or long-term strategic viability in a manner that would interfere with its ability to complete the merger transaction, or (b) is expected to materially delay, obstruct or impede the consummation of the merger. Notwithstanding the foregoing, for any event to be deemed a Corporate Material Adverse Impact under clause (a), such event shall not include, and shall be excluded from consideration if it arises solely from: (i) minor and industry-wide market fluctuations or general economic trends that affect all comparably situated companies; (ii) routine modifications to governmental regulations or changes in accounting standards adopted after the date of this Agreement, except where such modifications uniquely and adversely affect the Company; (iii) any effects directly attributable to the public announcement or media coverage of this Agreement; (iv) operational delays or adjustments expressly consented to in writing by Parent; or (v) any other changes that are only peripheral to the actual operational and transactional processes associated with consummating the merger. It is expressly stated that none of these exclusions shall be interpreted to relieve the Company of the obligation to consummate the merger if its ability to do so is directly impaired by a Corporate Material Adverse Impact.
